# Adding MESACLIP to CDEPS

*Generated by Claude.*

All changes are in draft PR
[CROCODILE-CESM/CDEPS#2](https://github.com/CROCODILE-CESM/CDEPS/pull/2), from the `mesaclip`
branch of [manishvenu/CDEPS](https://github.com/manishvenu/CDEPS/tree/mesaclip) on top of
`cdeps1.0.101` (the CDEPS tag CESM's `crocodash` branch uses). This repo carries the branch as the
`cdeps/` submodule. `code/add_mesaclip_to_cesm.py` regenerates the XML and registration edits; the
datamode Fortran is edited on the branch.

```bash
cd <cesm>/components/cdeps
git remote add mesawave https://github.com/manishvenu/CDEPS.git
git fetch mesawave && git checkout mesaclip
```

Most of the PR is standard data-model entry: compset modes, namelist values and stream
definitions (one stream per variable, see [stream construction](stream_construction.md)). This page
covers what goes beyond that.

## Five products

Each MESACLIP scenario is its own mode in DATM, DOCN and DICE, so a compset picks one scenario,
e.g. `DATM%MESACLIP-RCP85`, `DOCN%MESACLIP-RCP85`, `DICE%MESACLIP-RCP85`.

| Compset option | `DATM_MODE` | `DOCN_MODE`, `DICE_MODE` | GDEX dataset | Default member | Years |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `MESACLIP-HIST` | `MESACLIP_HIST` | `mesaclip_hist` | d651007 | 010 | 1920–2005 |
| `MESACLIP-RCP26` | `MESACLIP_RCP26` | `mesaclip_rcp26` | d651043 | 003 | 2006–2099 |
| `MESACLIP-RCP45` | `MESACLIP_RCP45` | `mesaclip_rcp45` | d651043 | 003 | 2006–2099 |
| `MESACLIP-RCP60` | `MESACLIP_RCP60` | `mesaclip_rcp60` | d651008 | 010 | 2006–2095 |
| `MESACLIP-RCP85` | `MESACLIP_RCP85` | `mesaclip_rcp85` | d651009 | 010 | 2006–2099 |

The years are the defaults for `DATM_YR_START` and `DATM_YR_END`, which DOCN and DICE also use,
with `DATM_YR_ALIGN = $DATM_YR_START` so model years are data years. RCPs stop at 2099 because the
name of the 2100 file differs between members, and RCP 6.0 stops at 2095 because its last ocean file
does too. `DATM_TOPO` is `observed`.

## XML variable: `DATM_MESACLIP_CASE`

The GDEX case name to read, which picks the ensemble member. It is in `env_run.xml`, and every
DATM, DOCN and DICE MESACLIP stream file path contains `$DATM_MESACLIP_CASE`, so one setting
switches all three components. Defaults are the members in the table above. To use another member:

```bash
./xmlchange DATM_MESACLIP_CASE=b.e13.BHISTC5.ne120_t12.cesm-ihesp-hires1.0.46-1920-2005.005
```

`code/add_mesaclip_to_cesm.py` reports which members have every file the streams list.

## Datamode code

Each component gets a `mesaclip` datamode, registered in its cap and `CMakeLists.txt`. Each is a
copy of an existing datamode, and every change from the copy is marked `MESACLIP:`.

**DATM**
([`datm_datamode_mesaclip_mod.F90`](https://github.com/manishvenu/CDEPS/blob/26c0f11a15d0d9aac0efbb9fbcaef2ee944fd5b6/datm/datm_datamode_mesaclip_mod.F90),
copied from CPLHIST):

- **Potential temperature and density**
  ([L279–280](https://github.com/manishvenu/CDEPS/blob/26c0f11a15d0d9aac0efbb9fbcaef2ee944fd5b6/datm/datm_datamode_mesaclip_mod.F90#L279-L280)):
  `Sa_ptem = T (p0/p)^(Rd/cp)` and `Sa_dens = p / (Rd T (1 + 0.608 q))`, from `TREFHT`, `PS` and
  `QREFHT`. MESACLIP doesn't save them.
- **10 m winds for WW3**
  ([L283–284](https://github.com/manishvenu/CDEPS/blob/26c0f11a15d0d9aac0efbb9fbcaef2ee944fd5b6/datm/datm_datamode_mesaclip_mod.F90#L283-L284)):
  exports `Sa_u10m`, `Sa_v10m`, which CPLHIST doesn't, set to the lowest-level winds `UBOT`,
  `VBOT`.
- **Rain and snow**
  ([L289–292](https://github.com/manishvenu/CDEPS/blob/26c0f11a15d0d9aac0efbb9fbcaef2ee944fd5b6/datm/datm_datamode_mesaclip_mod.F90#L289-L292)):
  from CAM's `PRECT`, `PRECC`, `PRECSC`, `PRECSL` (m/s), times fresh-water density to give kg/m²/s.
  Convective rain = `PRECC − PRECSC`, large-scale rain = `PRECT − PRECC − PRECSL`, snow =
  `PRECSC` and `PRECSL`.
- **Direct shortwave**
  ([L297–298](https://github.com/manishvenu/CDEPS/blob/26c0f11a15d0d9aac0efbb9fbcaef2ee944fd5b6/datm/datm_datamode_mesaclip_mod.F90#L297-L298)):
  `FSDS − SOLSD − SOLLD`, split between visible and near-IR in the JRA datamode's 0.28 : 0.31
  ratio
  ([L79](https://github.com/manishvenu/CDEPS/blob/26c0f11a15d0d9aac0efbb9fbcaef2ee944fd5b6/datm/datm_datamode_mesaclip_mod.F90#L79)).
  The diffuse bands are `SOLSD` and `SOLLD` as read.

**DOCN**
([`docn_datamode_mesaclip_mod.F90`](https://github.com/manishvenu/CDEPS/blob/26c0f11a15d0d9aac0efbb9fbcaef2ee944fd5b6/docn/docn_datamode_mesaclip_mod.F90),
copied from CPLHIST):

- **Currents**
  ([L148, L155](https://github.com/manishvenu/CDEPS/blob/26c0f11a15d0d9aac0efbb9fbcaef2ee944fd5b6/docn/docn_datamode_mesaclip_mod.F90#L144-L157)):
  `U1_1`, `V1_1` times 0.01, cm/s to m/s. They are not rotated from POP's grid axes to east/north.
  SST's °C to K conversion is CPLHIST's own.

**DICE**
([`dice_datamode_mesaclip_mod.F90`](https://github.com/manishvenu/CDEPS/blob/26c0f11a15d0d9aac0efbb9fbcaef2ee944fd5b6/dice/dice_datamode_mesaclip_mod.F90),
copied from SSMI):

- **Ice fraction**
  ([L408](https://github.com/manishvenu/CDEPS/blob/26c0f11a15d0d9aac0efbb9fbcaef2ee944fd5b6/dice/dice_datamode_mesaclip_mod.F90#L408)):
  `aice_d` divided by 100, % to fraction. Only `Si_ifrac` comes from MESACLIP.
